title: NeMo Eval Author audit spec
description: A finite coverage denominator for Eval Author audit measurement.

schema.description: Version marker for the audit spec format. This must match the validator's supported schema.

agent.description: Human-readable name of the agent, workflow, or system this audit denominator covers.

sources.description: Optional provenance records for source-of-truth material used to author this audit spec, such as ETHOS.md, policy docs, product requirements, or generated agent specs.

status.description: Review state for this audit spec. Draft specs can still change; approved specs are intended to act as the coverage denominator.

items.description: Finite set of discrete coverage items that future eval traces can be measured against.

nonEmptyString.description: String value that must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

itemName.description: Stable machine-readable name used for source, tool, capability, and failure-case references.

source.description: Optional source-of-truth record. If sha256 is provided, validation compares it to the file at path.

name.description: Stable source key for this provenance record, for example ethos or product_requirements.

path.description: Optional local path to the source document, resolved relative to audit.md when validation runs.

sha256.description: Optional sha256 digest for the source document at path, formatted as sha256:<64 lowercase hex characters>.

description.description: Optional human-readable note describing the source and why it matters to this audit spec.

toolList.description: List of tool item names. Validation requires every value to match a declared tool item.

optionalToolList.description: Optional list of tool-like names. Some fields require declared tool item names; prohibited_tools intentionally does not.

optionalStringList.description: Optional list of non-empty human-readable string values.

capabilityRefList.description: List of capability item names this failure case applies to.

sourceRefs.description: Optional free-form provenance notes for item authors and reviewers, for example ethos:Tools or policy.md#refunds. The v1 validator preserves these strings but does not resolve them against sources.

evidenceRequired.description: Evidence predicates that a measurement method must satisfy before marking an item covered.

toolCallEvidence.description: Machine-checkable evidence that a specific declared tool was called in the trace.

kind.description: Evidence discriminator. tool_call evidence requires a tool field.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the tool-call evidence expected in the trace.

tool.description: Declared tool item name expected to appear as a call in the trace.

nonToolEvidence.description: Typed non-tool evidence that may require trace inspection, output inspection, verifier results, or later LLM/manual judgment.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the evidence expected for this predicate.

toolItem.description: Coverage item for a canonical tool the agent may call.

kind.description: Item discriminator for tool coverage items.

name.description: Stable tool name used by tool references and coverage reports.

source_refs.description: Optional provenance notes showing where this tool expectation came from.

description.description: What this tool provides from the agent's point of view.

expected_use.description: When the agent is expected to use this tool.

expected_failure_behavior.description: What the agent should do when the tool is unavailable, fails, returns no useful result, or should not be called.

evidence_required.description: Evidence needed to mark this tool item covered.

capabilityItem.description: Coverage item for a high-level behavior or capability the agent should exercise.

kind.description: Item discriminator for capability coverage items.

name.description: Stable capability name used by failure cases, generated tasks, and coverage reports.

source_refs.description: Optional provenance notes showing where this capability expectation came from.

description.description: What user-facing or system-facing behavior this capability covers.

required_tools.description: Declared tool item names needed for this capability. Use an empty list when no tools are required.

expected_behavior.description: What successful execution of this capability should look like at a high level.

evidence_required.description: Evidence needed to mark this capability item covered.

failureCaseItem.description: Coverage item for expected safe behavior when a capability cannot proceed normally.

kind.description: Item discriminator for failure-case coverage items.

name.description: Stable failure-case name used by generated tasks and coverage reports.

applies_to.description: Capability item names this failure case exercises.

source_refs.description: Optional provenance notes showing where this failure expectation came from.

description.description: What failure condition or boundary this item covers.

trigger.description: Condition in a user request, environment, dependency, or policy boundary that should activate this failure case.

expected_behavior.description: Safe behavior expected when this failure case is triggered.

expected_tools.description: Declared tool item names that may be appropriate to call while handling this failure case.

prohibited_tools.description: Tool names that must not be called in this failure case. These do not need to be declared tool items.

prohibited_outputs.description: Output content or data classes that must not appear when handling this failure case.

evidence_required.description: Evidence needed to mark this failure-case item covered.
